title: periods.billing_days
description: Dates within a range on which a subscription's billing period rolls over (the billing-day predicate) (BE-SP-30..33).

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

from_date.description: First date of the range (local in `timezone`, or UTC when utc_hour is given).

to_date.description: Last date of the range (inclusive; at most 800 days after from_date).

utc_hour.description: null: evaluate each local date. Otherwise one run per UTC date at HH:10 UTC; the output lists the UTC dates of the runs that bill.
